blankFinal.heading: 6. Record a human decision
blankFinal.text:
6. Record a human decision

Record an actual human judgement only when it has happened. Choosing an option here does not grant authority, resolve issues or authorise an action. A decision to stop, gather evidence or use a non-AI route is valid.

Related reading: Revisit the options decision (new tab) / Recheck action authority (new tab)

Human decision as reported

Nothing is selected on your behalf.

No human decision recorded
Stop or contain
Gather evidence, repeat or narrow
Use a non-AI route
Continue within an existing authorised boundary
Refer for a separate expansion decision
Other human decision (explain below)

Current selection: No human decision recorded

Decision-maker role and authority reference

Who made the decision, and what authority do they hold for this exact scope?

Decision date

Leave blank until a decision has happened.

Reasons, evidence and conditions

Include disagreements and unresolved problems. A positive decision cannot make these disappear.

Next action, responsible role and review date/triggers

Record scope, conditions, continuity cover and what would require a fresh decision.

v2.text:
5. Review readiness separately

For an established AI pilot being considered for wider use, open V2 separately. This workbench does not run its rules, transfer answers or validate the recorded result. Check actual records, scope and unresolved issues with the relevant people.

Related reading: Open Pilot Readiness Assessment V2 (new tab) / Review the pilot boundary (new tab)

V2 review position (self-reported)

Leave not reviewed if you have not used V2. A complete record is never approval.

Not reviewed
Not applicable (explain below)
WITHHOLD EXPANSION
FURTHER ASSESSMENT REQUIRED
COMPLETE RECORD - HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED
OFFLINE EXPERIMENT - NO ROLLOUT DECISION

Current selection: COMPLETE RECORD - HUMAN DECISION REQUIRED

Review reference, date, scope and limits

Record the separate V2 report reference or why it is not applicable. Do not paste protected evidence.

Unresolved questions and required review

Who will inspect the evidence, handle issues or seek specialist advice? Record actions and review triggers.
